This Egyptian cross-sectional study examined 111 multidrug-resistant and carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates from 2020-2021. Carbapenem resistance was extremely high at 98.2%. Among K. pneumoniae, 23.9% were phenotypically colistin resistant, although no mcr genes were detected. blaNDM and blaOXA-48-like carbapenemase genes pre
